// Generated companion for a private P09 navbar adaptation. No app-kit runtime required.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// Navbar contains presentation labels and app-owned GET destinations. It does
// not supply authentication, notifications, sign-out, or account behavior.
type Navbar struct {
	IDPrefix      string
	Label         string
	MobileLabel   string
	Brand         NavbarBrand
	Links         []NavbarLink
	CurrentKey    string
	Notifications *NavbarDestination
	Account       *NavbarAccount
}

type NavbarBrand struct {
	LightURL string
	DarkURL  string
	Alt      string
}

type NavbarLink struct {
	Key   string
	Label string
	URL   string
}

type NavbarDestination struct {
	Label string
	URL   string
}

type NavbarAccount struct {
	Label    string
	ImageURL string
	Links    []NavbarDestination
}

// NewNavbar validates and snapshots caller-owned data before returning the
// source-styled component. An empty CurrentKey deliberately selects no link.
func NewNavbar(data Navbar) (templ.Component, error) {
	if err := validateNavbar(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshot := data
	snapshot.Links = append([]NavbarLink(nil), data.Links...)
	if data.Notifications != nil {
		notifications := *data.Notifications
		snapshot.Notifications = &notifications
	}
	if data.Account != nil {
		account := *data.Account
		account.Links = append([]NavbarDestination(nil), data.Account.Links...)
		snapshot.Account = &account
	}
	return guardedNavbar(navbar(snapshot)), nil
}

func validateNavbar(data Navbar) error {
	if !navbarIdentifier(data.IDPrefix) {
		return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid IDPrefix")
	}
	for _, field := range []struct{ name, value string }{
		{"Label", data.Label}, {"MobileLabel", data.MobileLabel},
	} {
		if !navbarText(field.value, 256) {
			return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid %s", field.name)
		}
	}
	if !navbarText(data.Brand.Alt, 512) || !navbarURL(data.Brand.LightURL) || !navbarURL(data.Brand.DarkURL) {
		return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid Brand")
	}
	if len(data.Links) < 1 || len(data.Links) > 12 {
		return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid Links")
	}
	keys := make(map[string]bool, len(data.Links))
	for _, link := range data.Links {
		if !navbarIdentifier(link.Key) || !navbarText(link.Label, 256) || !navbarURL(link.URL) {
			return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid link")
		}
		if keys[link.Key] {
			return fmt.Errorf("navbar: duplicate link key")
		}
		keys[link.Key] = true
	}
	if data.CurrentKey != "" && !keys[data.CurrentKey] {
		return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid CurrentKey")
	}
	if data.Notifications != nil && !navbarDestination(*data.Notifications) {
		return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid Notifications")
	}
	if data.Account != nil {
		if !navbarText(data.Account.Label, 256) || !navbarURL(data.Account.ImageURL) || len(data.Account.Links) < 1 || len(data.Account.Links) > 12 {
			return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid Account")
		}
		for _, link := range data.Account.Links {
			if !navbarDestination(link) {
				return fmt.Errorf("navbar: invalid account link")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func navbarDestination(value NavbarDestination) bool {
	return navbarText(value.Label, 256) && navbarURL(value.URL)
}

func navbarIdentifier(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 64 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for i, b := range []byte(value) {
		if i == 0 {
			if b < 'A' || b > 'Z' && b < 'a' || b > 'z' {
				return false
			}
			continue
		}
		if b != '_' && b != '-' && (b < 'A' || b > 'Z') && (b < 'a' || b > 'z') && (b < '0' || b > '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func navbarText(value string, limit int) bool {
	if len(value) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func navbarURL(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 2048 || strings.TrimSpace(value) != value || !utf8.ValidString(value) || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\ ") || navbarHasControl(value) {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
	if err != nil || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") || navbarHasControl(decoded) {
		return false
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") {
		return !strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") && !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == ""
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "https://") || u.Scheme != "https" || u.Hostname() == "" || strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") || strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ") {
		return false
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func navbarHasControl(value string) bool {
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func guardedNavbar(component templ.Component) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
			return component.Render(ctx, w)
		}
	})
}
